verdict.rationale: Abacum documents its own permissions system: group-based role assignment that lets admins assign and manage user permissions across the workspace from a code-free interface. Nothing shows those permissions can be scoped to a department or data subset so a budget owner sees and edits only their own numbers. missing for 10: evidence of department- or dimension-level data scoping, edit-versus-view restrictions limited to a budget owner's area, any detailed documentation of the permission model, independent or hands-on corroboration.
